summary: PRE-PUBLISH regression pass. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iter40_features.py — register/login/me OK; /founders/spots returns 100-based total and @test.com signup DOES NOT increment `taken` (test-email exclusion works); /leaderboard/xp + /leaderboard/defender exclude bots (@circle.ai) AND @test/@qa/@example emails and never leak email/phone/apple_sub (SEC-001 still enforced); /digest/weekly returns 200 with workouts key (no 500); /api/onboarding/baseline first-time saves prs {bench:200,squat:300,deadlift:400,ohp:130}, awards reward_xp=150, adds 'calibrated' badge, sets baseline_set=true, and recap.trend.first=true. Settings partial save (only bench provided) correctly keeps existing squat/deadlift/ohp PRs and returns reward_xp=0. All-zeros retest keeps everything unchanged. Retest with real values returns trend.first=false + big4_delta. Frontend (mobile 390x844): fresh @test.com register -> WHAT'S NEW dialog -> LET'S TRAIN -> pick-full -> BaselineStats prompt renders WITH testIDs baseline-save/baseline-skip (verified via screenshot /tmp/it40_baseline_stage.png). Pressing baseline-skip dismisses the prompt and OnboardingTour appears (testID tour-next visible). Entering values + baseline-save hides the prompt and it does NOT loop this session. Home (/(tabs)) does NOT contain 'YOUR WEEK' text — big digest card removed as required. Journey (/journey) does not currently render 'THIS WEEK' strip for a brand-new user because WeeklyDigestCard hides itself when xp_gained/workouts/races/trend/shield are all empty (correct by design, see WeeklyDigestCard.tsx:32). Leaderboard tab loads with LEVEL board; DEFENDERS entry lives inside the board-picker modal (not in initial DOM — same known automation gap flagged in iter39). Profile loads clean. Settings: MY BIG 4 LIFTS editor renders s-bench/s-squat/s-deadlift/s-ohp + save-lifts + retest-maxes testIDs; tapping save-lifts on a partial fill (only bench=225) correctly PATCHed via /api/onboarding/baseline and /api/auth/me confirmed prs.bench=225 while others were preserved (reward_xp=0). retest-maxes navigates to /baseline where testID baseline-back is visible. PAYWALL BUG STILL PRESENT (unchanged from iter38/iter39): rendered prices are $5.00 / $39.99 instead of required $9.00 / $90.00 — RevenueCat test-store package overrides the hard-coded fallback in /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx:80,86. Cleanup: 3 test accounts (usr_410bc18d6baf, usr_763c07c0ef9e, usr_18b4329776c5) deleted; 0 @test/@qa/@example emails remain; auth_limits cleared; /api/founders/spots stable at taken=10/remaining=90 (unchanged from run-start; the 10 count is because a real user streetfighter2131@gmail.com signed up during iter39 unrelated to these tests — flagged in iter39 report). No bots or test accounts appear on any leaderboard.

ui_bugs.issue: REGRESSION NOT FIXED across iter38/39/40. Rendered prices are $5.00/mo and $39.99/yr (RevenueCat *_test_store package) instead of required $9.00 / $90.00. paywall.tsx:80 uses `monthlyPkg?.product.priceString || '$9.00'` — the RC test store returns a truthy pkg so the $9 fallback never fires. Screenshot: /tmp/it40_paywall.png. Fix: (a) update RevenueCat test+prod offering in the dashboard to $9/$90, OR (b) hard-override the displayed priceString in paywall.tsx when running against EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_TEST_API_KEY.

🛡 DEFENDERS entry is inside a modal-driven board selector and is not in the initial DOM. Backend /api/leaderboard/defender works fine (test asserted). Add testID='board-picker' to the '💪 STRENGTH · LEVEL ▾' label Pressable AND testID='board-defender'/'board-<key>' on each option row so QA can exercise DEFENDERS board via automation.

rca_of_issue: Paywall $9/$90 mismatch (unchanged 3 iterations running): /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx:80 reads `monthlyPkg?.product.priceString || '$9.00'`. The RevenueCat test store returns a real package with priceString='$5.00' so the fallback constant is never reached. Fix by (a) updating both test + prod RevenueCat offerings to $9/$90 in the dashboard, or (b) `const displayPrice = __DEV__ || TEST_KEY ? '$9.00' : (pkg?.product.priceString || '$9.00')` — but option (b) will mislead real checkout in dev.
